Zero-Setup Push Notifications: Why GrowHaz Does Not Ask for Your Private Firebase Files

By GrowHaz Engineering Team — 2026-10-17

Learn how GrowHaz built a zero-friction, private push notification engine for Web-to-App conversion without asking users to upload sensitive Firebase private keys or credentials.

The Trust Problem with Traditional Converters

Asking users to upload Firebase Admin Service Account JSON files creates massive security risks and distrust. A service account key gives full administrative access to Google Cloud projects. Non-technical users find it complicated, and security-minded users refuse to share their credentials.

How GrowHaz Solved It

GrowHaz bakes an autonomous native Android notification engine directly into the generated APK. Your website can trigger native Android notifications via standard JavaScript when open, and the app manages background alerts without requiring third-party credentials.

Zero Config Requirements

You only need your Website URL and App Name. No Firebase accounts, no keys to generate, and zero documents to upload.
